title: Refinement coherence of reconstructed exceptional representing pairs
statement:
Fix distinct primes $p,\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p$, and a $k$-morphism $f:X\to Y$ between separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Fix a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, valuation ring $R$, uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Choose a compactification $c=(X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{g}Y)$, with $j$ open and $g$ proper [def-weil-compactifications-refinements].

Put $\widehat R_T=\varprojlim_n(A_n)_T$ and let $\mathcal I_T(R)$ be the completed integral constructible category [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]. Use the actual reduction/total-limit adjunction $\mathcal R_T\dashv\mathcal L_T$, $\mathcal L_T=R\varprojlim\operatorname{Res}$, with unit $u$ and counit $e$ [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Let $P_R:\mathcal I_X(R)\to\mathcal I_Y(R)$ be compact-support reconstruction, with its actual system comparison $\alpha_K:\mathcal R_Y P_RK\xrightarrow{\sim}F\mathcal R_XK$, where $F=Rg_{*,\bullet}j_{!,\bullet}$ on pro-etale towers [lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization]. Let $c^1,c^2$ be two compactifications of this same $f$, with a specified proper refinement $w:c^1\to c^2$ restricting to $1_X$. Write $F^i$ for their actual ordinary strict-system compact-support functors and $P_R^i$ for their reconstructions. The canonical refinement map of ordinary derived systems $q^{\mathsf S}:F^1\xrightarrow{\sim}F^2$, with direction fixed by its finite-level normalized proper/open comparison, is defined on bounded-below etale-origin systems; it is defined on the ringed diagram site of strict varying-coefficient systems by the open-adjoint construction: restrict to the open fibre product, project to the open-and-closed image of $X$, and take the open-adjunction transpose, followed by the direct-image compositor. The coefficient-compatible version uses the actual ringed-system construction of [lem-pur-ringed-refinement-coefficient-square, lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization]. It preserves the coefficient comparisons and satisfies identity, composition, independence of a common refinement and the cocycle. Its reconstruction $q_R:P_R^1\xrightarrow{\sim}P_R^2$ agrees with the compact-support comparison under the actual reduction comparisons $\alpha$.

Fix $L\in\mathcal I_Y(R)$ and, for each compactification, supplied normalized exceptional data as in [lem-pur-integral-reconstructed-representing-pair], with Brown systems $N^i$, supplied systems $M^i_\bullet$ and identifications $\theta_i:M^i_\bullet\xrightarrow{\sim}N^i$, and completed reconstructions $M^i\in\mathcal I_X(R)$. Use the counit-preserving right-adjoint mate $\rho^{\mathsf S}:N^2\to N^1$ of $q^{\mathsf S}$ at $\mathcal R_YL$. Suppose $s:M^2_\bullet\xrightarrow{\sim}M^1_\bullet$ is an actual derived-system map with $\theta_1s=\rho^{\mathsf S}\theta_2$; in the single-degree alternative the compatible finite-level maps determine this $s$ by good truncation. Then, with $\bar s=\mathcal L_Xs$ and reconstructed counits $t_R^i:P_R^iM^i\to L$, one has
$$t_R^1\circ P_R^1(\bar s)=t_R^2\circ q_{R,M^2}.$$
The integral representing Hom bijections commute with these maps. These assertions respect successive refinements, a common dominating compactification, and coefficient extension. Rational realization and extension to the finite-extension-valued $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ carry these equations to the analogous condensed equations. If $J_i$ are specified right adjoints of $P_\Omega^i$, $c_i:M_\Omega^i\xrightarrow{\sim}J_iL_\Omega$ are the representing transposes, and $\rho:J_2\to J_1$ is the mate of $q_\Omega:P_\Omega^1\to P_\Omega^2$, then
$$c_1\circ s_\Omega=\rho_{L_\Omega}\circ c_2.$$
All maps here exist in the ordinary derived categories of systems before reconstruction; equality of such maps is not inferred solely from finite evaluations.

source.place: Counit-preserving comparison, together with the varying-coefficient ringed-system refinement construction of lem-pur-ringed-refinement-coefficient-square and the formal lem-sp-compactification-refinement-coherence; agent application, returned item proof Step 13.

proof.text: Retain the already-proved intrinsic finite-evaluation invertibility and bounded etale-origin transfer in the unchanged data module. Generic five-factor conjugation cancels comparison isomorphisms and equivalence counits; use systemRefinement_id and systemRefinement_comp to prove system_id and system_comp.

Use reconstructedRefinementCommon for the two common-refinement independence conclusions. The system cocycle cancels the identical middle systemComparison and its inverse. Choose a common refinement of the three integral endpoints, use independence to rewrite all three ratios on it, and cancel the middle integral comparison to prove the general cocycle.

The actual integralRefinement is obtained by whiskering the system map through restriction and total limit and lifting to a full subcategory. Functoriality transports system identity and composition; inverse isomorphisms give integral_id and integral_comp. Cancel the inverse integral comparison against its forward arrow in ComparisonFamily.refinement.reduction to prove reduction.

The Brown Hom formula and apply_symm_apply prove mate_counit directly from its definition. Use reconstructedBrownMateLaws for invertibility and composition, and reconstructedRefinementSingleDegree for the common-degree recognition square.

Use reconstructedRefinementTraceSquare for the integral counit equation. The published Hom naturality gives B(h)=P(h) followed by its identity trace. Substitute the counit equation and naturality of comparison to derive the Hom clause.

Use reconstructedRefinementTraceTransport for scalar, field and closure counit equations. Functoriality and naturality of each comparison yield the field and closure Hom clauses for every test object. Transpose the final equation under adjunction one; Mathlib conjugateEquiv_counit and naturality identify the second transpose with the closure equation, so injectivity proves transpose.

Apply reconstructedRefinementTraceSquare twice from a common dominating compactification. Total limit preserves the supplied isomorphism composition and inverses. Cancel the forward comparison to the first endpoint, use its naturality and both trace equations, and obtain common_pair_counit.

Cancel the specified compact-support scalar comparison in the scalar identity equation. ComparisonFamily.scalar_identity followed by naturality of integralScalarId proves scalar_identity. Likewise use scalar_composition and naturality of integralScalarComp to prove scalar_transitive for arbitrary traces, including ramified extensions.

proof_origin.place: Transposes, Naturality and Uniqueness; actual eight-step Lean reduction with five strictly smaller substeps.
